intro.p1: ViaHost web hosting is managed shared hosting with cPanel on NVMe disks and a 10 Gbps network, in European datacenters (Amsterdam and Germany). It includes SSL, daily backups, free migration and DDoS protection.
intro.p2: Pricing is flat: what you see at signup is what you pay on every renewal, with no increases and no fine print. The cPanel account is created automatically once payment is confirmed.

faqItems.q: Does the price go up on renewal?
faqItems.a: No. Pricing is flat: you pay the same at signup and on every renewal, with no fine print.

faqItems.q: Can I migrate my site from another host?
faqItems.a: Yes, migration is free: we move your site and mailboxes from your current host.

faqItems.q: How long until it is active?
faqItems.a: Setup is automatic on payment: your cPanel account is created in seconds and the credentials are emailed to you.

faqItems.q: Does it include SSL and backups?
faqItems.a: Yes. Automatic Let's Encrypt SSL for every domain and daily backups with one-click restore.
